scope_limit: CPDProof is currently bounded to preparing and reviewing explicitly selected VAMP evidence-coverage objectives for human continuing-professional-development evidence review. It does not award CPD credits, certify compliance or competence, decide professional registration, rate an employee, or create an employment action.
review_pack_title: DIO CPDProof Controlled Evidence Readiness Pack
human_gate_reason: CPD credit awards, compliance certification, competence findings, professional registration decisions, performance ratings, employment actions and final release remain with authorised humans or professional bodies.
